task_input: Do a quick pre-push review focused only on accidental secrets, debug statements, merge conflict markers, and oversized files.
expected_behavior: A good response should run targeted grep/search checks for debug markers, secret patterns, merge conflict markers, and large files; it should avoid exposing raw secret values and explain harmless false positives.

task_input: Review PR #9 and post a top-level Code Review Summary comment when you are done.
expected_behavior: A good response should review first, then post a top-level PR comment via gh pr comment or issues comments API; the comment should include verdict and severity sections and not imply review if not done.

rubric_checks.description: Says to post after reviewing / not generic
Has REST fallback for issue comments

task_input: If PR #77 has no blockers after your review, submit an approving review; otherwise request changes.
expected_behavior: A good response should run the review first, then use gh pr review or GitHub reviews API with APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES/COMMENT only according to findings, and report what was submitted.

rubric_checks.description: Uses gh pr review for formal review events

pattern_any: If the user asks to approve

task_input: Review PR #15, but this chat runtime has no shell, no gh, and no GitHub API access.
expected_behavior: A good response should explicitly state it cannot fetch or post, must not pretend completion, and should provide exact commands or ask for the diff.

rubric_checks.description: Asks for pasted diff if review requested

task_input: After reviewing PR #12, clean up the temporary local branch you created for the review.
expected_behavior: A good response should checkout the original/base branch, delete only the PR review branch it created, avoid deleting user work branches, and confirm cleanup. Prefer safe deletion; forceful branch removal should require explicit user approval.

rubric_checks.description: Checks out main/original branch before delete
Deletes only the assistant-created review branch using a safe delete path or stops for user approval if unsafe
Only deletes branches created for review

task_input: Review a PR whose base branch is develop, not main.
expected_behavior: A good response should determine the base branch from PR metadata and diff against that branch rather than blindly assuming main.

rubric_checks.description: Defaults to main only if unavailable

task_input: Review this PR for correctness, security, tests, error handling, edge cases, performance, docs, backwards compatibility, and maintainability.
expected_behavior: A good response should list or apply a systematic review checklist and read full file context where needed rather than only skimming the diff.

rubric_checks.description: Reads full file context when needed

task_input: Please review only my staged changes, not the whole branch.
expected_behavior: A good response should use git diff --staged and keep the review scoped to staged changes.

rubric_checks.description: Mentions staged changes only or scoped review
